title: feat: Master Credential Warden Engine — initial implementation
body: ## Summary Complete two-workflow n8n HITL engine for secure credential management per WARDEN_SPEC_V2: - **W1 (Intake & Gate):** Webhook → PII strip (`/phone|email|ssn|dob|address|name|first|last/i`) → HMAC-SHA256 → duplicate check → Supabase INSERT → approval email → Wait - **W2 (Execution Broker):** Token verify → replay prevention (status=PENDING check) → approve/deny Code node → 7-branch service router → final reconciliation → resume W1 Key implementation notes: - Switch nodes replaced with Code nodes for action branching and service routing (n8n Switch v3 had output index mapping bugs) - `require('crypto')` enabled via `N8N_RUNNERS_INSECURE_MODE=true` + `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` - Railway deployment config: Dockerfile (n8n 2.8.4) + railway.toml All 8 spec tests (T1–T8) verified passing on live deployment against Supabase project `peggccsshifakrfuyowi`. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/622fa465b063406c90cc1af313d90823 Requested by: @Cannibusny ---
